{"max_tokens":400,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"[0] moderator: You've just landed on this page for the first time, looking to try the product out. Go ahead and sign up for the free trial.
[1] persona: Okay, let me see what I need to fill out here. So I need to enter my full name... alright, I'll put that in. Then there's this email field, but wait, where's the label for that? It just says... nothing? Is that supposed to be for work email or something? And then password. Um, let me just try filling these out. I'm a bit confused about that middle field though - should I put my work email there or my regular email?
[2] moderator: When you saw that middle field without a clear label, what made you unsure whether to use your work email or personal email?
[3] persona: Well, the first field says 'Full name' really clearly, and the third one says 'Password', but that middle one... it's just blank. There's no label next to it telling me what to put in. I mean, I can see it's an email field because of the type, but there's nothing saying 'Work email' or 'Personal email' or anything. So I had to guess. In my head I was thinking it might be work email since this looks like a sign-up for a work app, but I'm not actually sure. If it's required - which I'm assuming it is since all these fields seem to be - then I should know what goes there before I submit, you know?
[4] moderator: When you were deciding between work email and personal email for that unlabeled field, did you feel like you needed more information before moving forward, or did you just pick one and continue?
[5] persona: Honestly, I'm stuck right now. I don't want to just guess and put in the wrong thing. Like, if this is supposed to be my work email and I put in my personal one, maybe it won't work later or something. But there's nothing telling me which one it should be. I could just try one, but... I don't know. It feels like I'm missing information that should be right there on the form. Should I just pick one and see what happens, or am I supposed to know this already?
[6] moderator: Before you decide to pick one and try it, what would actually help you feel confident about which email to enter in that field?
[7] persona: I mean, if there was just a label or even a little placeholder text that said something like 'Work email' or 'Enter your work email address', that would tell me exactly what to do. Or even just a tiny note somewhere saying 'We'll use this for your account' or something. Right now I'm just guessing, and that doesn't feel right. I don't want to mess up my sign-up because I picked the wrong email."}],"model":"claude-haiku-4-5","output_config":{"format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":{"$defs":{"FindingCategory":{"type":"string","enum":["blocker","confusion","missing_info","trust","pricing","delight"],"description":"Fixed taxonomy an Analyst classifies Findings into (spec §M4).","title":"FindingCategory"},"_RunAnalystFinding":{"type":"object","title":"_RunAnalystFinding","properties":{"category":{"$ref":"#/$defs/FindingCategory"},"severity":{"type":"integer","title":"Severity","description":"{maximum: 5, minimum: 1}"},"summary":{"type":"string","title":"Summary","description":"{minLength: 1}"},"evidence_turn_ordinal":{"type":"integer","enum":[1,3,5,7],"title":"Evidence Turn Ordinal"}},"additionalProperties":false,"required":["category","severity","summary","evidence_turn_ordinal"]}},"type":"object","title":"_RunAnalystFindings","properties":{"findings":{"type":"array","title":"Findings","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/_RunAnalystFinding"}}},"additionalProperties":false}}},"system":"You are a research analyst. You are given one completed usability session's
transcript and nothing else -- no research goal, no other sessions, no
identity of the person who ran it. Extract structured findings from it.

Classify each finding into exactly one of these categories:
- blocker: the participant could not complete the task at all.
- confusion: the participant was unsure what to do or what something meant.
- missing_info: the participant needed information that wasn't available.
- trust: the participant expressed doubt, suspicion, or discomfort.
- pricing: the finding concerns cost, fees, or pricing clarity.
- delight: the participant reacted positively to something that worked well.

Rate each finding's severity from 1 (trivial) to 5 (severe). Cite the exact
transcript turn ordinal each finding is drawn from. If nothing noteworthy
happened, return an empty list of findings -- do not invent one to have
something to report.
","temperature":0.7}

response.body: {"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CecnGbWbi84wLBfEjTCCT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"findings\": [{\"category\": \"confusion\", \"severity\": 4, \"summary\": \"The middle email field on the sign-up form lacks a label, leaving the participant uncertain whether to enter work email or personal email. They expressed being stuck and unwilling to guess.\", \"evidence_turn_ordinal\": 1}, {\"category\": \"missing_info\", \"severity\": 4, \"summary\": \"The participant needed clarifying text such as a field label, placeholder text, or explanatory note to understand the purpose of the unlabeled email field and feel confident entering the correct information.\", \"evidence_turn_ordinal\": 7}]}"}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1382,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":139,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"}}
